column1: # dashboard_parked.tsv — expiry-dated "quiet by design" register for the Fleet-Ops dashboard.
#   - parked_until = YYYY-MM-DD, MANDATORY — the agent's planned re-activation date.
#     Past it, normal staleness flagging resumes AUTOMATICALLY (parking can never
#     hide a genuinely dead agent). No permanent parking, by design.
#   - Effect while live: fleet grid shows a neutral "parked → date" chip instead of
#     aging/lagging/cold, and the agent is excluded from staleness attention flags.
#     Inbox-depth flags still apply (parked ≠ excused from mail).
# MAINTENANCE: PROME owns rows; add one when a session decides an agent goes quiet
#   until a known date; delete or renew when plans change.
